identity_cost.detail: a China-site Alibaba Cloud account: registration needs a mobile number that can receive an SMS code, '注册前只需要准备一个...可以接收短信验证码的手机号码...即可，注册账号流程相同。', and '注册完成后，在充值和购买云产品之前需要完成账号的实名认证'. Individual verification takes '输入个人认证的姓名和身份证号码，开始认证，个人身份校验成功后进行扫脸', that is a name, an identity-card number and a face scan. The sandbox bills per second from the account balance ('账户余额不足导致欠费时，系统将发送欠费通知'), so the real-name check comes before use.

record.confidence_note: the billing overview was read on 2026-10-22 (help.aliyun.com, Chinese). It prices three lifecycle states separately and states a 15 GiB free disk allowance. There is no free compute allowance, so the free tier is the disk and the record says so

evidence.proved: three states priced separately: '活跃' bills vCPU, memory and disk; '深休眠' snapshots the whole instance including memory to persistent storage and bills disk only; '浅休眠' bills memory and disk and is entered automatically when 'CPU 消耗 < 0.01 core', '网络流量 < 1,000 Bytes/s' or '无请求触发'; and '磁盘享受 15 GiB 免费额度'. Deep sleep loses the 15 GiB free disk…

record.provider: Alibaba Bailian / DashScope File API (QwenCloud SG)

free_tier.stated: 100 GB total per workspace and 10,000 files, with no stated expiry: '百炼存储空间支持的最大文件数为10000个，总大小不超过100 GB，暂时没有有效期限制。' Per file: 150 MB for purpose=file-extract and 500 MB for purpose=batch.

egress.terms: No metered egress on file retrieval. The legacy get-file endpoint returns a pre-signed aliyuncs.com OSS URL, i.e. served from Alibaba OSS rather than a billed gateway.

record.interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible: base_url https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 with the openai SDK; also https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com for international, and https://maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1 for the Singapore QwenCloud brand
record.tooling: openai-python with a swapped base_url; curl multipart; documented endpoints upload/retrieve/list/delete plus GET /files/{file_id}/content
record.chaining: 100 GB per workspace, and workspaces are a creatable dimension. 'Never expire' is the whole point: this is the only major /v1/files endpoint found that gives permanent retention on the free tier. At 500 MB/batch file, 10,000 files = 5 TB of nominal slots against a 100 GB byte wall. The byte wall binds.

limits.value: review status (`checking` -> `available`/`rejected`) before they can be referenced

record.limits_note: per-object-cap 150 MB (file-extract) / 500 MB (batch). 100 GB workspace byte cap and 10,000-file count cap, whichever hits first. Files enter a safety-review status (`checking` -> `available`/`rejected`) before they can be referenced.

identity_cost.detail: an email address plus a mobile number from outside the Chinese mainland, for security verification, on the international site; real-name verification is required only to use Chinese-mainland resources or to apply for a credit line, and whether a card is asked for was not read.

record.reliability_note: TWO CONTRADICTORY READ PATHS depending on which generation of the API you use. The NEW Agent Studio `GET /files/{file_id}/content` documents 'only files with downloadable=true can be downloaded; files uploaded directly or copied into a session sandbox are downloadable=false and return 400'. A read gate. The file-list example on the same doc set literally shows `"downloadable": false` on a directly uploaded CSV. But the LEGACY `GET /api/v1/files/{file_id}` returns a signed OSS `url` in the metadata, which is a real read path. The docs say the legacy interface is 'mainly for compatibility with historical scenarios', so its survival is not guaranteed. Probe the legacy path before relying on it. Alibaba Cloud international registration is email + mobile (any-phone); Chinese-mainland identity verification (passport/driver's licence) is only required for products deployed in mainland China.

evidence.proved: '百炼存储空间支持的最大文件数为10000个，总大小不超过100 GB，暂时没有有效期限制' (10,000 files, 100 GB, no expiry); '单个文件最大为 150 MB' for file-extract; batch 500 MB
'You can store up to 10,000 files and 100 GB total. Files never expire.' — the Singapore/international wording of the same product

evidence.proved: the 150 MB per-file ceiling for file-extract is unchanged
evidence.quote: 将purpose指定为`file-extract`，文件格式支持文本文件（ TXT、DOCX、PDF、XLSX、EPUB、MOBI、MD、CSV、JSON），图片文件（BMP、PNG、JPG/JPEG、GIF和PDF扫描件），单个文件最大为 150 MB。

free_tier.stated: A CNY 300 no-threshold voucher quoted as 通过学生认证的高校学生，可领取300元云工开物学生专属优惠券, plus access to a student compute package across thirteen instance shapes. The credit is real and large for this market; the door is the finding.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: With an enrolled affiliate, this is the single largest no-card cloud credit found in the Chinese market and it stacks with the student priced instances, which are sold separately from the voucher.
record.limits_note: Nothing throttles the voucher itself, but the status lapses after 30 days and the account cannot be re-verified after graduation, so the credit is a one-shot that cannot be renewed by waiting.
record.binding_note: Nothing throttles the voucher itself, but the status lapses after 30 days and the account cannot be re-verified after graduation, so the credit is a one-shot that cannot be renewed by waiting.

identity_cost.detail: Verification requires full-time enrolment at a mainland Chinese higher-education institution, checked against the national student register, on an account that has already passed Alipay real-name certification. One account per identity card, and the student status expires every 30 days and must be re-verified. The vendor states that students in Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan go through manual review instead, so the general route is closed to anyone not enrolled in a Chinese institution.
